maintenance_rules: Do not infer historical provenance from current default output paths.
Do not delete, move, rename, or overwrite uncertain result artifacts.
Record every result migration before changing result paths.
Stop on ambiguous provenance, output collisions, unknown dynamic output directories, or unintended scientific changes.
Validate with relevant tests, compileall, git diff --check, and repository-maintenance audit when those tools are present.
